profile.headline: Software Developer at LTC Ally
profile.summary: Experienced software developer who is passionate about developing seamless and user-friendly web applications. A self-motivated, detail-oriented learner with experience in user and employee training and strong leadership skills. Experience in web development utilizing both low-code SaaS platforms and JavaScript-based custom solutions.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed and administered 15+ Quickbase web applications using JavaScript, jQuery, Python, SQL, 
and native Quickbase languages
Developed applications focused on data management and automation for internal business users
Developed 5+ web applications for external clients, designed for data retrieval and management
Developed 20+ custom webpages using JavaScript and jQuery to integrate with the Quickbase platform
Developed web application in PHP with Laravel
Recommended solutions by developing database structures using Data Flow Diagrams and ERDs, 
assessing platform capabilities, security, and long-term maintenance
Troubleshooted and resolved client issues with web applications and integrated software
Consumed RESTful APIs via JavaScript, URLs, Webhooks, and Quickbase Pipelines
positions.insights: PHP, Microsoft SQL Server and +9 skills

volunteerExperiences.description:
Retrieved and restocked medical supplies and medications.
Delivered lab samples and retrieved results.
Responded to patient queries & managed incoming phone calls.
